edition: ASI / InfraBuild (OneSteel) hot-rolled, welded and cold-formed hollow section tables (AS/NZS 3679.1:2016, AS/NZS 3679.2:2016, AS/NZS 1163:2016 ranges)
source: Published tables (see 'sources' and skyframe/docs/SECTION_SOURCES.md). Values not printed by the source are computed exactly from the published dimensions and listed per shape in 'computed'.

sources.ASI: Australian Steel Institute / InfraBuild (OneSteel) section property tables to AS/NZS 3679.1 (hot-rolled), AS/NZS 3679.2 (welded WB/WC) and AS/NZS 1163 (cold-formed hollow), as transcribed in daveh07/steel_tables_cli @bf69739 (MIT), data/*_PROPS.json (ASI design-capacity-table format)
sources.ASI-TFB: OneSteel/InfraBuild TFB table (AS/NZS 3679.1) as transcribed in jamesmaguire/site-structural-webapp (GPL-3.0), static/steelsections.json
sources.SA-RO: Outside corner radius r_out of each AS/NZS 1163 RHS/SHS from Folded-Structures-Lab/steel-as @3b65004 (MIT), src/steelas/data/AUS_hollow_sections.csv

conventions: local 3 = major axis, 2 = minor; d along local 2. Channels: back of web at 3=0, flanges toward +3. Angles (EA/UA, long leg d along +2, heel at origin): I33/I22 = ASI In/Ip about the leg-parallel centroidal axes, I_major/I_minor = ASI Ix/Iy (principal), alpha = angle (rad) from local 3 to the major principal axis, positive toward +2. x0/y0 = shear centre minus centroid along 3/2. As2 = d*tw, As3 = 5/3*bf*tf (I/channel); 5/6*d*t, 5/6*b*t (angle); 2*d*t, 2*b*t (RHS); A/2 (CHS). Z = plastic modulus (ASI 'S'), S = elastic modulus (ASI 'Z').
